# Contributing

This is Aaron Lin's personal portfolio repository. Corrections to broken links, accessibility problems, and rendering defects are welcome.

For code changes:

1. Create a focused branch from `master`.
2. Keep public content factual and supported by a source document.
3. Do not add private contact details, credentials, local paths, resume source, or unpublished team material.
4. Run `bundle exec jekyll build --strict_front_matter`.
5. Review the affected page on desktop and mobile in light and dark themes.
6. Open a pull request explaining the visible change and the validation performed.

Questions about the upstream theme belong in the [Academic Pages repository](https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io). This repository contains a customized portfolio and does not send changes back to the template.
